Letmoro — step access

Letmoro reads today’s step total from Health Connect to display your activity. Only step reading is requested from Health Connect. Optional physical activity access enables faster step feedback while the app is open.

Imported daily step totals and travel credits are stored in your local save to prevent double counting. They are not sent to a server. No automatic life penalties apply.

You can revoke access in Health Connect at any time. Missing data never counts as zero steps.
